member.name: T:Fuxion.Analyzers.Abstractions.HasMembersRequiringNotNullAttribute
member.summary: Indicates that specific members of this type require non-null values and will throw exceptions when accessed with null. This attribute is primarily used as a workaround for extension members where individual member attributes are not visible to Roslyn analyzers.

remarks.para: This attribute should be applied to the containing type (usually the type being extended) and lists the names of members that enforce non-null constraints.

This is a temporary workaround for C# 14 extension members. Once Roslyn properly exposes attributes on extension member symbols, this attribute can be removed in favor of applying directly to individual members.
